items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: finally Don Albert came to Tulsa and Melvin Moore was with him

ctx.x: And so, anyway, then we got to kind of move on, there I was, it looked like I always had those good vocalists, and at that time that was what was setting the band then. Now, T. Holder had Billy Maxted and I would talk to T and I don't know anybody this and

that, and so finally Don Albert came to Tulsa and Melvin Moore was with him, and I had been going wild over Roy and Pee Wee, but now this is it. And so, he told me, I don't know he said, I told my dad I was going to finish high school anyway and I think he said next year I'm going back to school, I just got one year.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: he was arranging for the band, old man, Tulsa, Planet Fields

ctx.x: What did you hear of Rene Hall play?

Well, the first time I heard him, it was in the Middle East before he left. And he used to live next to my Uncle Jim McCann's house. And then when I went to Tulsa, he was, like I told you, in three years of talk, he was arranging for the band, old man, Tulsa, Planet Fields. What instrument did he play? He was a guitarist. That's all. I imagine you could play saxophone. Well, I imagine you play most of the strings. It's no problem to play strings if you play one.
A lot of guys double on bad gear in guitar. That's right.
